title: Avengers officers / MCU villains demonstration import
notes: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Fictional identities. Not loaded into the app.
Place this file at the repo root and use it to test File → Import JSON.
Do not write this payload into localStorage unless you are testing import.
Admin roster matches copdoc.admin.v1 (officers, vehicles, shifts).
Leads/people match copdocx.store.v1. Export rules: committed only; Gravik is draft.
Map pins come from lead locations with targetPriority and latitude/longitude.
Officer and villain street addresses are real public places (ICE field offices, civic buildings, stadiums, hotels) so they plot. They are not real homes of the actors.
Officers = Avengers film cast. Alien/lead subjects = MCU villains.
